title: Contract cancellation body
description: A cancellation of a contract by consent (register row JO5; spec-delta S1701): one party signs it and the other cosigns, so neither can cancel for the other (cancellation_not_a_party, cancellation_needs_consent). It names a fee in credits that the principal pays the performer out of the escrow for the work done, never more than the price (cancellation_fee_over_price) and none before a Bond locked anything (cancellation_fee_without_escrow). A contract is cancelled before it is delivered (cancellation_too_late) and once (cancellation_known). The Bank then settles with basis revoked, and the settlement must release exactly the fee, take no job tax and slash nothing (settlement_mismatches_cancellation); a delivery or an acceptance on a cancelled contract is refused (contract_cancelled). Subject: the contract. Chain: none (prev is null).

fee.description: What the principal pays the performer for the work done, from the escrow.
